meta.name: modlens
meta.description: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别图片内容并转成文字，让没有视觉功能的AI也能读取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常用文本型AI处理带图消息，却总遇到无法识别图片的困境。
copy.tagline_en: Extract text and content from images, letting text-only AI models read them.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often send images to a text-only AI and get no useful reply.

howto.what: 当对话里出现图片而 Claude 看不到内容时，它会调用 modlens 把图片转成结构化 JSON（含全文转录、版面区域、语义与视觉线索），并依据这些证据回答。用户询问安装、配置、切换服务商时也会处理。
howto.when: 当对话中出现图片路径/URL（.png 等扩展名）或 [Image #1] 这类占位符，而你看不到图片内容时触发；用户询问安装、配置或切换 modlens 服务商时也会触发。

say.text: 用 modlens 读一下 /tmp/photo.jpg，告诉我里面写了什么
say.note: 会调用 modlens 输出图片 JSON 证据后回答。

say.text: 这张粘贴的图里有哪些文字？
say.note: 对 [Image #1] 占位符也会触发 modlens。

say.text: 帮我配置 modlens 用 Gemini API key

howto.what_en: When an image appears and Claude cannot see its content, it runs modlens to turn the image into structured JSON evidence (full text transcription, layout regions, semantics, visual clues) and answers from that. It also handles questions about installing, configuring, or switching modlens providers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an image path/URL (e.g. .png) or a pasted-image placeholder like [Image #1] appears and the model cannot see the image, and when the user asks about installing, configuring, or switching modlens providers.

say_en.text: Run modlens on /tmp/photo.jpg and tell me what it says.
say_en.note: Runs modlens and answers from its JSON evidence.

say_en.text: What text is in this pasted image?
Configure modlens to use a Gemini API key.
